# CG-REQ-001: New required request body property

A property was added to a request schema and is required.

**Why it matters:** Requests valid under the baseline lack the new required property.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.propertyAdded` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> New required property "{property}" in {where}.
>
> Existing consumers do not send "{property}", so a provider that enforces the candidate will reject their requests.
>
> **Fix:** Make "{property}" optional (with a server-side default), or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: required property added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [c], properties: {a: {type: string}, c: {type: string}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. New required property "c" in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Fires: nested inside array items

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: array, items: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: array, items: {type: object, required: [c], properties: {a: {type: string}, c: {}}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. New required property "c" in POST /x: the request body (application/json) at `[]`.

### Does not fire: optional property added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}, c: {type: string}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: required readOnly property added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id], properties: {a: {type: string}, id: {type: string, readOnly: true}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- A server-side default for missing values cannot be seen in the specification.
